profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Kuali, Inc.
profile.summary: I am a dedicated Software Development Engineer with 9 years of experience in the field looking for a full-time opportunity. I am proud for my ability to collaborate with others, adapt to changing needs, and provide creative, detailed-oriented solutions to business challenges. As a life-longer learner, I continuously grow in my abilities and can quickly utilize new techniques and technologies.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
•	Implemented a browser chat client in ReactJS with Elixir backend.
•	Collaboratively designed & implemented enterprise SSO solution hosted on AWS from beginning to end. Used VueJS for Admin page. Implemented logging solution using Splunk.
•	Mentor junior engineers in the completion of difficult tasks through paired programming.
•	Scrum master for team.
•	Worked on Client - Network Layer - Server software utilizing C++, C# in .NET 4.5, ASP.NET, Java, JavaScript, and HTML
•	Applied Agile Methodology and collaborated with team members to fulfill new functionalities request from Project Managers/Customers over multiple Sprints for Spaces by Moxie product.
•	Daily tasks include team discussions, researching, designing, and developing new features. Aiding Professional Services to handle customer escalations. Maintaining current and previous product versions.
•	Conduct performance & load test on software before release utilizing Performance Monitor to analyze CPU & Memory usage as well as DebugDiag for thread hangs/freezes and crashes.

positions.title: Student
positions.description: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science and Systems, Minor in Mathematics

positions.title: Avionic Navigation & Communications Technician
positions.description:
•	Manage work load distribution and documentation.
•	Handle administrative correspondence for unit.
•	Integrate up to 200 systems at a time into network & handle client support.
•	Coordinate training & airspace reservations between agencies & locals.
•	Attend Production Control meetings & present progress reports.
•	Inspect and supervise maintenance actions.
•	Manage acquisition, storage, and handling of hazardous materials.
•	Conduct Technical Training sessions.
•	Assemble and de-assemble mobile facilities.
•	Counsel and motivate subordinates in technical, professional, and personal capacities.
•	Maintain training records for work center.
•	Troubleshoot and isolate errors in aviation navigations and communications equipment.
•	Manage reservist personnel on drill weekends.
•	Perform corrosion control on mobile maintenance facilities.
•	Manage acquisition and inventory of “Pre-Expended Bin” parts.
•	Perform duties as Safety representative for work center.
